row:
GOAL 1
Cultivate a “preservation
ethic” in the community
through an active outreach
program

Strategy 1:
Encourage local advocates
to speak to the benefits of
historic preservation

Strategy 2:
Support community
involvement in
preservation, including
historically
underrepresented areas,
through an enhanced
and user-friendly web
presence

Strategy 3:
Collaborate with
Destination Bryan and
other local
organizations to create
and sustain active
preservation activities

GOAL 2
To act as historic
preservation advocates for/
to all Departments, Boards,
and Commissions of the City
of Bryan, and provide
leadership in integrating
those municipal programs
that impact preservation

Strategy 1:
Host annual joint
meetings between various
boards and commissions
to engage elected and
appointed officials and
discuss action items of
the Historic Landmark
Commission

Strategy 2:
Support individual
commissioner’s
participation as speakers
on preservation-related
topics to local
organizations

Strategy 3:
Establish regularly
occurring agenda item
for Historic Landmark
Commission meetings
to discuss the status of
the preservation plan
and annually review
possible amendments
and report findings to
the City Council

GOAL 3
To record and promote the
history of the people and the
development of Bryan

Strategy 1:
Integrate existing
resources together with
this plan to provide a
centralized, easily
accessible, information
repository

Strategy 2:
Fund continued
collection of oral and
written stories

Strategy 3:
Recognize and identify
historically
underrepresented
groups

GOAL 4
To preserve and enhance all
historic structures in Bryan
through an active
Designation program

Strategy 1:
Complete a
comprehensive update of
the Historic Resources
Survey

Strategy 2:
Promote and maintain
the Bryan Landmark
Marker program through
various channels of
communication

Strategy 3:
Provide guidance for
citizens who seek
further historic
designation

GOAL 5
To provide preservation
services to the community
through guidelines,
seminars, and review
processes

Strategy 1:
Provide training
opportunities to staff and
the Historic Landmark
Commission

Strategy 2:
Provide public seminars
and workshops
highlighting best
practices in historic
preservation

GOAL 6
Promote historic
preservation as a catalyst for
economic development

Strategy 1:
Collaborate with
preservation partners and
organizations to promote
heritage tourism

Strategy 2:
Continue funding the
Downtown Improvement
Program grant

Strategy 3:
Study potential impact
of tax rebate programs,
and recommend
appropriate action to
the City Council
